usual_baseline: Maintenance fluids are rarely prescribed to guideline. Recommended fluid 16% [2262]; correct composition 0% [2360]; none to NICE [2436]. Too much sodium and too little potassium: 295% excess sodium, 82% less potassium [2031]. U&Es pre-checked in 10% [2327]. Fluid balance recorded 38% [2730].
fix_that_works: An electronic TrakCare review proforma plus teaching: fluid balance 38% to 78%, heart rate 35% to 96% [2730]. Targeted teaching: optimal resuscitation 43% to 83%, sodium met 66% to 91.7% [2662]. Teaching and posters: maintenance when indicated 52% to 84% [2360].
fix_that_fails: Teaching and posters leave composition poor. Correct composition 0% to 15% [2360]; glucose met in 24% and potassium in 16% [2453]. Posters and emails: recommended fluid 16% to 38% [2262]. Appropriate fluid types 36% to 45.5% [2662]. Tutorial and algorithm gave only 'some improvement' [2124].
consultant_advice: Overdone in surgical juniors, with the same finding each time. Teaching raises volumes but not potassium or glucose content. More useful to audit electrolyte harm, such as hyponatraemia and hypokalaemia, or build a review template into the electronic record.
